```{r}
#| label: setup
#| include: false

library(reactable)
library(htmltools)
library(dplyr)
library(jsonlite)

MUTILS <- "C:/Users/vince/hh/pq/PDS/mutils/jrr"
BASE <- "C:/Users/vince/hh/pq/PDS/pbnb-airbnb-log-jrr-jpy"

source(file.path(MUTILS, "jcn-reactable.R"))
source(file.path(MUTILS, "jcn-ddict.R"))

# Adapter load_ddict pour le JSON pbnb (indicators vs indicateurs)
load_ddict_pbnb <- function(path) {
  raw <- jsonlite::fromJSON(path, simplifyVector = FALSE)
  indics <- raw$indicators
  indics <- indics[!grepl("^_", names(indics))]
  themes <- raw$themes

  parse_col <- function(col) list(base = col, periode = NULL)

  label <- function(col) {
    e <- indics[[col]]
    if (!is.null(e)) return(e$short %||% col)
    col
  }
  unit <- function(col) {
    e <- indics[[col]]
    if (!is.null(e)) return(e$unit %||% "")
    ""
  }
  type <- function(col) {
    e <- indics[[col]]
    if (!is.null(e)) return(e$type %||% "")
    ""
  }
  theme_of <- function(col) {
    e <- indics[[col]]
    if (!is.null(e)) return(e$theme %||% "")
    ""
  }
  definition <- function(col) {
    e <- indics[[col]]
    if (!is.null(e)) return(e$description %||% e$long %||% "")
    ""
  }
  theme_label <- function(tk) {
    e <- themes[[tk]]
    if (!is.null(e)) return(e$label %||% tk)
    tk
  }
  periode_label <- function(col) NULL
  source <- function(col) { e <- indics[[col]]; if (!is.null(e)) e$source %||% "" else "" }

  list(label = label, unit = unit, type = type, theme_of = theme_of,
       definition = definition, theme_label = theme_label,
       parse_col = parse_col, periode_label = periode_label, source = source)
}

dd <- load_ddict_pbnb(file.path(BASE, "reports/helpers/ddict-airbnb.json"))

kpi <- read.csv(file.path(BASE, "data/interim/kpi_global_by_city_2506.csv"),
                fileEncoding = "UTF-8-BOM")
agg <- read.csv(file.path(BASE, "data/interim/kpi_global_by_aggregate_2506.csv"),
                fileEncoding = "UTF-8-BOM")

# Colonnes par dimension (ordre du ddict)
C_PRS <- c("prs_listings_1000hab_dense", "prs_density_l_km2_dense", "prs_pct_listings_dense",
           "listings_1000hab", "listings_1000hsg", "entire_1000hsg")
C_VOL <- c("vol_n_ann", "str_n_entire", "vol_n_hotes")
C_STR <- c("str_entire_pct", "str_minnuits30_pct", "str_minnuits90_pct", "str_cap_pers_med", "str_ratio_ann_hote")
C_PRO <- c("cr_offre_1plus", "cr_host_1plus", "cr_offre_5plus", "cr_host_5plus",
           "cr_offre_top10host_pct", "cr_hosts_offre50_pct")
C_PX  <- c("px_entire_med", "px_entire_q25", "px_entire_q75", "px_entire_iqr",
           "px_private_med", "px_1br_med", "px_2br_med")
C_ACT <- c("act_cal_ouvert_med", "act_revenu_med", "act_reserv_j_med",
           "actrv_note_glb", "act_superhost_pct", "str_instantbook_pct", "actrv_avis_mois")
C_CTX <- c("pop", "housing", "ctx_pop_dense", "ctx_densite_pop_dense", "ctx_aire_dense_km2")
C_ALL <- c(C_PRS, C_VOL, C_STR, C_PRO, C_PX, C_ACT, C_CTX)

# Labels pour toolbar
KPI_LBL <- setNames(sapply(C_ALL, dd$label), C_ALL)
KPI_THEMES <- list(
  "Pression" = C_PRS, "Volume" = C_VOL, "Offre" = C_STR,
  "Pro" = C_PRO, "Prix" = C_PX, "Performance" = C_ACT, "Contexte" = C_CTX
)

# Types override :
#   rank = barres bordeaux(fort)/gris(median)/bleu(faible) centrees médiane — indicateurs clés
#   level = barres grises — indicateurs complémentaires
#   pop/num = pas de barre
TYPE_RANK <- c("prs_listings_1000hab_dense", "prs_density_l_km2_dense",
              "listings_1000hab", "listings_1000hsg",
              "px_entire_med", "px_entire_q25", "px_entire_q75",
              "cr_offre_1plus", "cr_offre_5plus",
              "act_revenu_med", "act_reserv_j_med", "actrv_note_glb")
TYPES_OVR <- setNames(
  ifelse(C_ALL %in% TYPE_RANK, "rank", "level"),
  C_ALL
)
# Pop/housing = format separateur, pas de barre
TYPES_OVR[c("pop", "housing", "ctx_pop_dense")] <- "pop"
TYPES_OVR[c("vol_n_ann", "str_n_entire", "vol_n_hotes")] <- "pop"
TYPES_OVR[c("ctx_densite_pop_dense", "ctx_aire_dense_km2")] <- "num"
```

::: {.panel-tabset}

### Par ville

```{r}
#| label: rt-villes
#| column: screen

df_v <- kpi |>
  filter(scope == "city") |>
  arrange(desc(vol_n_ann)) |>
  mutate(.rank = row_number())

# Colonnes sticky (identite)
cols_id <- list(
  .rank = colDef(name = "#", width = 35, align = "center", sticky = "left",
                 style = list(fontWeight = 700, background = "#fafafa", borderRight = "1px solid #ddd")),
  city_fr = rt_col_lib(df_v, "city_fr", "Ville", mw = 130),
  continent = colDef(name = "Cont.", width = 85, align = "left",
                     style = list(fontSize = "11px"),
                     filterInput = function(values, name) {
                       tags$select(
                         onchange = sprintf("Reactable.setFilter('rt-villes', '%s', event.target.value || undefined)", name),
                         tags$option(value = "", "Tous"),
                         lapply(sort(unique(values)), function(v) tags$option(value = v, v)))
                     }),
  country_code = rt_col_tag("Pays", w = 42)
)

# Colonnes KPI via ddict
cols_kpi <- rt_cols_ddic(df_v, C_ALL, dd, types = as.list(TYPES_OVR), light = FALSE)

# Groupes header
grps <- list(
  colGroup(" ", c(".rank", "city_fr", "continent", "country_code"), headerStyle = RT_GRP),
  colGroup("Pression", C_PRS, headerStyle = RT_GRPBL),
  colGroup("Volume", C_VOL, headerStyle = RT_GRPBL),
  colGroup("Nature offre", C_STR, headerStyle = RT_GRPBL),
  colGroup("Professionnalisation", C_PRO, headerStyle = RT_GRPBL),
  colGroup("Prix EUR/nuit", C_PX, headerStyle = RT_GRPBL),
  colGroup("Performance & qualite", C_ACT, headerStyle = RT_GRPBL),
  colGroup("Contexte territorial", C_CTX, headerStyle = RT_GRPBL)
)

browsable(tagList(
  mk_toolbar("rt-villes", nrow(df_v),
    col_labels = KPI_LBL, themes = KPI_THEMES,
    fullscreen = TRUE, col_filter = TRUE,
    title = "74 villes — Indicateurs par dimension",
    subtitle = "Barres bleu/bordeaux = indicateurs cles | Barres grises = indicateurs complementaires"),
  rt_table(df_v, c(cols_id, cols_kpi), groups = grps,
    id = "rt-villes", sticky_cols = 2, height = 600,
    searchable = TRUE, sorted = list(vol_n_ann = "desc"))
))
```

### Sub-cities BAB

```{r}
#| label: rt-bab
#| column: page

C_BAB <- c("vol_n_ann", "listings_1000hab", "prs_listings_1000hab_dense", "prs_pct_listings_dense",
           "listings_1000hsg", "px_entire_med", "px_entire_q25", "px_entire_q75",
           "str_entire_pct", "cr_offre_1plus", "cr_host_1plus",
           "act_cal_ouvert_med", "act_revenu_med", "actrv_note_glb", "act_superhost_pct",
           "pop", "ctx_pop_dense", "ctx_densite_pop_dense")

df_bab <- kpi |> filter(scope == "sub_city" | city == "pays-basque")

cols_bab <- c(
  list(city_fr = rt_col_lib(df_bab, "city_fr", "Ville", mw = 140)),
  rt_cols_ddic(df_bab, C_BAB, dd,
    types = as.list(setNames(ifelse(C_BAB %in% TYPE_RANK, "rank", "level"), C_BAB)),
    light = FALSE)
)

rt_table(df_bab, cols_bab,
  id = "rt-bab", height = "auto",
  sorted = list(vol_n_ann = "desc"))
```

### Par pays (groupBy)

```{r}
#| label: rt-pays
#| column: screen

C_AGG <- c("vol_n_ann", "listings_1000hab", "listings_1000hsg",
           "px_entire_med", "px_entire_q25", "px_entire_q75",
           "str_entire_pct", "str_minnuits30_pct", "str_ratio_ann_hote",
           "act_cal_ouvert_med", "actrv_avis", "actrv_avis_mois")

# Preparer un df city avec country pour groupBy
df_pays <- kpi |>
  filter(scope == "city") |>
  arrange(country_code, desc(vol_n_ann)) |>
  select(country_code, city_fr, all_of(C_AGG))

cols_pays <- c(
  list(
    country_code = colDef(name = "Pays", width = 50, align = "center",
      style = list(fontWeight = 700, fontSize = "11px")),
    city_fr = colDef(name = "Ville", minWidth = 130, align = "left",
      style = list(fontWeight = 500, fontSize = "11px"),
      aggregate = NULL)
  ),
  rt_cols_ddic(df_pays, C_AGG, dd,
    types = as.list(setNames(ifelse(C_AGG %in% TYPE_RANK, "rank", "level"), C_AGG)),
    light = FALSE)
)

# Ajouter aggregate functions sur les colonnes numeriques
for (col in C_AGG) {
  if (is.numeric(df_pays[[col]])) {
    if (col %in% c("vol_n_ann")) {
      cols_pays[[col]]$aggregate <- "sum"
    } else {
      cols_pays[[col]]$aggregate <- "median"
    }
    cols_pays[[col]]$format <- list(aggregated = colFormat(digits = 0, separators = TRUE))
  }
}

browsable(tagList(
  mk_toolbar("rt-pays", nrow(df_pays),
    col_labels = setNames(sapply(C_AGG, dd$label), C_AGG),
    fullscreen = TRUE, col_filter = FALSE,
    title = "74 villes groupees par pays",
    subtitle = "Cliquer sur le triangle pour deplier un pays"),
  reactable(df_pays,
    columns = cols_pays,
    groupBy = "country_code",
    compact = TRUE, highlight = TRUE, bordered = FALSE,
    searchable = TRUE, pagination = FALSE,
    height = 600,
    defaultSorted = list(vol_n_ann = "desc"),
    defaultColDef = colDef(
      align = "center", searchable = FALSE,
      headerStyle = list(background = "#f5f5f5", fontSize = "11px",
                         fontWeight = "600", padding = "3px 4px"),
      style = list(padding = "1px 3px", fontSize = "11px")),
    theme = reactableTheme(
      cellPadding = "1px 3px",
      style = list(fontFamily = "Inter, system-ui, sans-serif", fontSize = "11px")),
    elementId = "rt-pays")
))
```

```{r}
#| label: rt-monde

C_MONDE <- c("n_villes", "vol_n_ann", "str_n_entire",
             "listings_1000hab", "listings_1000hsg",
             "px_entire_med", "px_entire_q25", "px_entire_q75", "px_entire_iqr",
             "px_private_med", "str_entire_pct", "str_minnuits30_pct", "str_ratio_ann_hote",
             "act_cal_ouvert_med", "actrv_avis", "actrv_avis_mois")

df_monde <- agg |>
  filter(level %in% c("world", "continent")) |>
  arrange(match(level, c("world", "continent")))

cols_monde <- c(
  list(
    level = colDef(name = "Niveau", width = 80, align = "left",
      style = function(val) list(fontWeight = if (val == "world") 700 else 500)),
    continent = colDef(name = "Continent", width = 110, align = "left",
      style = list(fontWeight = 600))
  ),
  rt_cols_ddic(df_monde, C_MONDE, dd,
    types = as.list(setNames(ifelse(C_MONDE %in% TYPE_RANK, "rank", "level"), C_MONDE)),
    light = FALSE)
)

rt_table(df_monde, cols_monde, id = "rt-monde", height = "auto")
```
